records.text: The viewer Mandy cited Matthew 10:14, Mark 6:11 and Luke 9:5 as teaching that Jesus did not force people to accept his message, criticizing Kolvet and Erika for forgetting this.
records.speaker: Mandy (Ep 389 viewer/commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Wear Forbidden [online handle as transcribed; spelling unverified]. That sounds like a job for @WearForbidden on X. He makes the best AI videos, and yes, it's like they all just wanted the power, all of them: Erika (Erika Kirk), Andrew Kolvet, Blake Neff. It'll all be mine. And that's why they're crashing out, and they're angry at us, and they're sending all of these goons to attack people who are investigating the Charlie Kirk assassination, which is just wild. Mandy (viewer/commenter; surname unverified) writes, yet again, Andrew Kolvet and Erika Kirk forget their Bible ... and Jesus (Jesus Christ) is teaching about not forcing people to accept his message. Jesus (Jesus Christ) tells the disciples to shake the dust off their feet, Matthew 10, 14, Mark 6, 11, and Luke 9, 5.
